summary:
CEILING AIR DEVICES — 31 total to purchase (28 supply diffusers + 3 return grilles). Manufacturer basis-of-design is PRICE, per the GRILLES schedule on M601; quantities counted off the tags on M101 (Mechanical New Work Floor Plan). All are new — MD101 shows the existing grilles removed and demo keynotes say "see new work drawings for installation of NEW grille," so nothing is salvaged or reused.

SUPPLY DIFFUSERS (28 ea, 6,550 CFM total)
Types A–D are Price "SCD": louvered-face square 4-cone steel ceiling supply diffuser, 4-way (360°) pattern, WHITE, full-faced louvers, factory-insulated backpan, in a 24x24 panel for lay-in ceiling, with radial balancing damper in the neck (Price VCR9 or equal), NC ≤ 35:
- Type A — SCD, 6" round neck — 5 ea (75/75/75/90/130 CFM)
- Type B — SCD, 8" round neck — 4 ea (150/150/140/140 CFM)
- Type C — SCD, 10" round neck — 15 ea (250/200/250/250/250/200/350/350/350/300/375/375/300/375/375 CFM)
- Type D — SCD, 12" round neck — 1 ea (500 CFM, Kilns 115)
- Type J — Price "SMD" louvered-face HIGH CAPACITY steel ceiling supply diffuser, 12x12 face with 8" round neck, WHITE, 4-way, with opposed blade damper, flanged frame for surface mounting — 3 ea (175/150/150 CFM), in Tlt F 121, Tlt M 123 and Vest 125

CEILING RETURN/EXHAUST GRILLES (3 ea)
- Type F — Price model 80, 24"x24" CORE-ONLY panel, all-aluminum 1/2"x1/2"x1/2" egg-crate return/exhaust grille, WHITE, in 24x24 lay-in panel — 3 ea: one in MP Room 119, two in Mtg Room 106. No CFM tagged. Keynote 4 on M101: provide a new 24x24 lined (1/2" liner) plenum atop each new egg-crate return grille; the existing 15x12 duct (field verify) is modified to tap the new plenum. Keynote 28: provide rectangular-to-round adapter atop return grille.

ALSO IN THE CEILING BUT NOT A GRILLE PURCHASE
- Three ceiling exhaust fans come with an INTEGRAL GRILLE, so do not order separate ceiling grilles for them: EF-1 and EF-2 = Greenheck SPA-700, 450 CFM ea; EF-3 = Greenheck SP-B90, 75 CFM. All are centrifugal ceiling exhaust fans with integral grille, flapper backdraft damper, plug/cord set, mounting brackets, factory grille-mounted motion sensor, factory disconnect and speed controller.
- One untagged item, M101 keynote 19: a 14"x14" egg crate, PRICE MODEL 82, mounted in a SOFFIT with insect screen on the back (outside-air intake at FCU-1). Add 1 ea if you are carrying soffit devices with the ceiling package.

NOT CEILING — DO NOT INCLUDE (these are sidewall/wall grilles, 15 ea): Type E (4 ea, 30x18 heavy-duty steel sidewall return, primecoat — keynote 7 says the engineer could not field-measure, dimensions are approximate, FIELD VERIFY before ordering); Type G (4 ea, 36x36 sidewall transfer grille, primecoat, top elevation 14'-8" AFF per keynote 3); Type H (3 ea, Price 520D 18x8 double-deflection sidewall supply, 550 CFM ea); Type I (4 ea, Price 520D 14x8 double-deflection sidewall supply, 450 CFM ea, FIELD VERIFY per the schedule asterisk).

ORDERING NOTES FROM THE SCHEDULE: primecoat grilles (E, G, H, I) get 2 coats of field paint — verify color with architect; ceiling types A–D, F and J are white factory finish. The gymnasium (107) has no new grilles — only two unit heaters (UH) and PHP. General note 3 on M601: coordinate ceiling register locations with lighting, sprinklers and ceiling grid; refer to architectural reflected ceiling plan A6-1 for exact locations.
